zh: 天气面板重新排版：左边一列是城市名和它下面的空气质量，右边一列是天气图标、当前温度和今天最高最低温度，两边各成一列、不再挤成一长行。
空气质量与 PM2.5 后面加了冒号，读起来更像一句话：「空气质量：42 · 优 · PM2.5：18」。
打开天气面板时背后的桌面真正虚化了：磨砂底加深到能挡住内容，面板再加一层浅遮罩，只是隐约透出壁纸的颜色，不再糊成一片黑或透出字来。
打开天气面板、日历等面板时，右上角的时钟、天气和设置那组图标会跟着淡出，不会浮在虚化背景上抢视线。
en: The weather panel's head is laid out in two columns: the city with its air quality beneath on the left, the condition glyph with the current reading and today's high and low on the right, instead of one long cramped row.
Air quality and PM2.5 now carry a colon, so the line reads as a sentence: "Air quality: 42 · Good · PM2.5: 18".

Opening the weather panel now really frosts Home behind it: the frosted backdrop is darkened enough to hide what is under it and the panel adds a light veil, so only a hint of the wallpaper's colour comes through instead of a flat black or legible text.
While the weather, calendar and other panels are open, the clock, weather and Settings icons at the top right fade out with them instead of floating over the frosted backdrop.

zh: 桌面守护：开机或待机唤醒后，如果电视弹出系统的「选择主屏幕」框（原生或厂商自绘的），守护会直接关掉它回到小黑DESK，不再卡在框上、遥控器像失灵一样。
老电视的画质：只支持 OpenGL ES 2 的 GPU（晶晨 S905L4、Mali-450 一类）上首页大号时钟边缘发虚，这类机型改为先在 CPU 上画好再显示，数字重新变锐利；其他机型行为不变。
天气更耐断网：连续失败会按 3、6、12……分钟退避重试（最长 1 小时），并且停在首页或屏保时也会自己重试，不用回一次桌面才刷新。
天气旧读数保留：12 小时内的读数继续显示，超过 3 小时会在旁边标「N 小时前」，不再整行消失让人以为坏了；加密连接超时会改走明文重试一次。
打开文件夹后最后一排被屏幕下沿切掉：现在选中哪一排，整排连同名字都会滚进屏幕。
输入密码（儿童模式等）时方向键不再跑到面板后面看不见的地方，按一次就往下走。
慢开机机型：机型配置里「开机时让原桌面显示多久」的上限从 10 秒放宽到 45 秒（小米 4A 一类固件约 29 秒才准备好）。
诊断报告新增一行天气状态（不含城市名），「天气不显示」时能直接看出是没取到、还是被隐藏了。
en: Home Guard: when the TV puts up the system's Home chooser (Android's own or a firmware's copy) after a boot or a wake, the guard closes it and returns to xiaoheiDESK instead of sitting on the dialog with a dead-looking remote.

Older GPUs: on a GPU with OpenGL ES 2 only (Amlogic S905L4, Mali-450 and the like) the large clock's digits came out soft at the edges; the digits are now drawn on the CPU on those sets, sharp again. Other TVs are unchanged.
Weather survives a blocked line: retries back off 3, 6, 12 ... minutes (an hour at most), and keep trying while Home or its screensaver stays up, instead of only when Home comes back.
An old weather reading stays: up to 12 hours it is still shown, with its age past 3 hours, instead of the row going blank; a TLS timeout is retried once over plain HTTP.
In a folder with several rows the last one is no longer cut by the screen's edge: the focused row scrolls fully into view with its name.
On the PIN pad (leaving Kids mode and elsewhere) the arrows no longer move focus behind the panel and out of sight.
Slow-booting sets: the device profile's “how long to leave the stock launcher up at power-on” now goes up to 45 s, from 10 s (Xiaomi 4A-style firmware is ready about 29 s in).
The diagnostics report has a weather line (no place name), so “no weather” can be told apart from “weather hidden”.

zh: 提升对华为鸿蒙 2/3/4 智慧屏（底层 Android 6–10）的兼容性：U 盘名画屏保现在能在这些机型上真正读到 U 盘里的图片。
存储权限改为按需申请：首次选择 U 盘屏保时会弹出系统授权框，同意一次即可；已经设成 U 盘屏保的，升级后首次启动会问一次。
Android 10 上补上了读取 U 盘所需的兼容开关，Android 6–9 上同样生效；Android 11 及以上行为与之前完全一致。
桌面、屏保、图库、手机遥控、桌面守护、应用内升级都没有其他变化，覆盖安装后原设置继续生效。
en: Better support for Huawei smart screens running HarmonyOS 2/3/4 (Android 6-10 underneath): the USB art screensaver can now actually read pictures from the drive on those sets.
The storage permission is asked for when it is needed: the system dialog appears the first time you pick the USB screensaver, and once on first launch if the USB screensaver is already selected.
Android 10 gets the compatibility switch needed to read a USB drive, and it applies on Android 6-9 too; on Android 11 and later nothing changes.
Home, screensaver, gallery, phone remote, Home Guard and in-app updates are otherwise unchanged, and existing settings keep working after the update.

zh: 内部命名统一：应用里的类名、文件名、主题名、字符串资源、日志标签、线程名和诊断输出，都改用 xiaoheiDESK 自己的名字；中文以外的界面文案也统一显示 xiaoheiDESK。
功能和设置一项没动：桌面、屏保、图库、手机遥控、桌面守护、应用内升级全部照旧，覆盖安装后原来的设置继续生效。
抓日志时标签变了：用 XiaoheiGuard、XiaoheiStream、XiaoheiDiag 等标签。
手机遥控的「反馈诊断信息」页也跟着更新，复制出来的机型报告仍能被正确识别版本。
en: Internal names are now consistent: class names, file names, the theme, string resources, log tags, thread names and diagnostics all use xiaoheiDESK's own naming, and the UI in every language outside Chinese shows xiaoheiDESK.
Nothing else changes: Home, screensaver, gallery, phone remote, Home Guard and in-app updates all stay as they were, and existing settings keep working after the update.
Log tags changed with it: use XiaoheiGuard, XiaoheiStream, XiaoheiDiag and so on.
The phone remote's diagnostics page is updated too, so a copied device report still has its version recognised.

zh: 修复 U 盘 / 名画屏保刚打开时黑屏几秒的问题：在桌面闲置的最后 8 秒，就提前把 U 盘图库扫描好、第一张画解码好，屏保一出现直接显示，不再先黑一阵。
原有的随机播放、四层装裱画框、深色玻璃背景、画名、慢淡出和切换间隔都不变。
en: Fixed the few seconds of black when the USB / gallery screensaver first opens: in the last 8 idle seconds on Home, the picture list is scanned and the first painting is decoded ahead of time, so the screensaver shows it immediately instead of opening onto black.
Random order, the four-layer mount, the smoked-glass backing, captions, the slow fade and the switch interval are all unchanged.

zh: 在线名画新增 15 幅中国画（全部横屏、来自克利夫兰艺术博物馆 CC0 收藏）：髡残、王蒙、沈周、查士标、梅清、李士达、郎世宁等，以山水画为主。
屏保设置新增「名画范围」：全部混合 / 只看国画 / 只看国外名画，默认全部混合，随时可切换。
原有 29 幅国外名画、随机播放、画框、画名、切换间隔等都不变。
en: Added 15 Chinese paintings to the online gallery, all landscape-oriented and from the Cleveland Museum of Art's CC0 collection: Kuncan, Wang Meng, Shen Zhou, Zha Shibiao, Mei Qing, Li Shida, Castiglione and more, mostly landscapes.
A new Art collection setting in the screensaver options: All mixed / Chinese only / Western only, default All, switchable any time.
The original 29 Western paintings, random order, frame, captions and slide interval are unchanged.

zh: 屏保背景墙改成深色玻璃，和小黑TV 频道面板同一块材料：近黑的近中性色、顶部 160dp 的白色高光、一点透进来的冷光和暖光，整块铺满屏幕，没有圆角也没有边框线。
白色画框按美术馆装裱重做成四层，总宽仍是 22dp：最外 5dp 略深的框条、17dp 象牙白卡纸、一条 2dp 的纸芯白边、贴画处 1dp 的斜切暗边——画看起来是嵌进卡纸里，而不是贴上去的。
画与画之间改为交叉淡化：新画约 0.9 秒到位，上一幅在被覆盖的同时继续淡出 2.4 秒，不再是一瞬间消失。
画名、22dp 等宽、随机播放、切换间隔都不变。
en: The wall behind the frame is now the same smoked glass as 小黑TV's channel panel: near-black neutral, a white sheen across its top 160dp, a whisper of cool and warm light inside, stretched edge to edge with no rounded corners and no rim line.

The white frame is rebuilt as a gallery mount in four layers, still 22dp in total: a 5dp moulding outside, a 17dp ivory board, a 2dp white core where the board is cut, and a 1dp shadow of that cut against the picture — so the painting reads as mounted, not pasted on.
Pictures now cross-fade: the new one is solid in about 0.9s while the previous one keeps dimming underneath for another 2.4s, instead of vanishing in a frame.
The name, the even 22dp width, the random order and the switch interval are unchanged.

zh: 屏保背景墙改成 iOS 26「液态玻璃」那种材质：不再偏暖米色，而是一层几乎无色的清澈玻璃——墙面只是淡冷的灰白，色相很轻微；玻璃本身几乎没有雾面感，只在四边内侧留一道极细的白色高光，顶边最亮、底部最淡，四角缓缓沉入中性的暗部。
白画框提亮为接近纯白，在浅色玻璃前层次更清楚；画名、22dp 等宽框、随机播放都照旧。
en: The wall behind the frame is now liquid glass in the iOS 26 manner: no longer warm beige but clear and almost colourless — a cool grey-white wall with only a faint tint, the pane itself nearly free of frost, defined instead by a hairline of white light just inside the screen's edges, brightest along the top and fading round the corners.
The white frame is lifted close to pure white so it still reads against the pale glass; the name, the even 22dp frame and the random order are unchanged.

zh: 屏保背景改成苹果风格的毛玻璃：暖白色玻璃后面透出柔和的色彩光斑，表面一层极细的霜面颗粒，顶部有一道冷光、四边略深，画框像挂在玻璃前。
画名、白框宽度、随机播放都照旧。
en: The screensaver backdrop is now frosted glass in the Apple manner: soft colour glowing through warm white, a fine frost over the surface, a cold glint along the top edge and slightly deeper edges, with the frame hanging in front of it.
The name on the painting, the 22dp frame and the random order are unchanged.

zh: 画名改为直接印在画作本身的下方（画内），不再在画下单独留一条白纸；白框四边因此恢复完全等宽。
屏保背景换成米色墙纸：暖米色纸面、极淡的竖向上墙纹、上方来光，四角微暗，画框在墙上有投影。
名画改为随机播放：每次进入屏保从不同的画开始，顺序不再固定（U 盘里的画仍按你的排列顺序）。
en: The painting's name now sits on the picture itself, near its lower edge, instead of on a strip of white board left under it; the frame is an even 22dp on all four sides again.
New wallpaper backing: warm beige paper with faint vertical stripes, light from above, softly darkened corners, and the frame casting a shadow on the wall.
The museum paintings now play in a random order: each visit starts somewhere else instead of walking the same sequence (your own USB pictures keep the order you arranged them in).

zh: 白色画框的边宽恢复固定：四边都是 22dp，不再为了铺满屏幕而加宽。
画框（含画作正下方的名字卡纸）在一个方向上顶满电视：横画顶满高度、宽幅画顶满宽度，另一个方向居中显示。
新增挂画背景墙：「相框适应画作」时画作挂在暖灰色的墙面上，画框带一层轻投影，不再是纯黑背景。
en: The white frame is a fixed 22dp on all four sides again, no longer widened to fill the screen.
The frame (with the strip the name is printed in) reaches the screen's edge in one direction — height for a tall picture, width for a very wide one — and is centred in the other.
New gallery wall: in Frame to Art the picture now hangs on a warm grey wall with a soft shadow under the frame, instead of on pure black.

zh: 画框改为铺满电视的一个方向：横画时画框与电视同宽、上下居中；竖画时画框与电视同高、左右居中。画作四周的白色卡纸（留白）随画作比例自动加宽。
「相框适应画作」时画名印在画作正下方的白色卡纸上（深色字），不再落在黑底上。
en: The frame now spans the screen in the picture's own direction: a wide picture gets a frame as wide as the screen, centred vertically; a tall one gets a frame as tall as the screen, centred horizontally. The white mount grows to suit the picture.
In Frame to Art the painting's name is printed in ink on the white mount just under the painting.

zh: 修复屏保白框：画作整体向内收一圈，「相框适应画作」时白框上、下、左、右四条边都能看到，不再只出现左右两条。
「相框适应画作」时，画作的名字改为显示在画的正下方、居中；其他屏保模式的名字位置不变。
en: Fixed the screensaver frame: the picture now sits inside the mat, so Frame to Art shows the white border on all four sides instead of only left and right.
In Frame to Art the painting's name now sits centred directly under the painting; the name stays where it was in every other screensaver mode.

zh: 屏保不再显示左上角的时间，画面只留画作本身。需要时可在 个性化 → 屏幕保护程序 → 时间 里重新打开。
修复「相框适应画作」：白色画框改为紧贴画作边缘，不再画在屏幕最外圈。
新增「切换间隔」：15 / 30 / 60 / 120 秒，默认 30 秒；照片、名画和 U 盘画作都按这个时间切换。
修复个别图片无法解码时会删除 U 盘原图的问题：现在只跳过那张，不动你的文件。
en: The screensaver no longer shows the time in the corner; the picture is left to itself. Turn it back on under Personalize → Screen saver → Time.
Fixed Frame to Art: the white frame now hugs the painting's own edge instead of being drawn round the screen.
New Slide interval: 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 seconds, 30 by default; photos, gallery and USB pictures all follow it.
Fixed a bug where a picture that would not decode could delete the original file on the USB drive; it is now skipped and left alone.

zh: 「U盘画作」屏保左下角的字幕不再显示「U盘 / USB」字样，只显示画作本身的名字。
en: The USB Art screensaver caption no longer shows U-disk / USB; it now shows only the artwork's own name.

zh: 「名画」和「U盘画作」的「画作显示」选项改名为「填充」和「相框适应画作」：填充会裁掉边缘铺满屏幕，相框适应画作让整幅画完整显示、比例不同处留黑边。
en: Renamed the Gallery / USB Art Picture fit options to Fill and Frame to Art: Fill crops the edges to cover the screen, Frame to Art shows the whole picture with black bars where its shape differs.

zh: 「名画」和「U盘画作」新增「画作显示」选择：可选「完整」（整幅画都显示、比例不同处留黑边）或「填满」（裁掉边缘铺满屏幕）；默认完整。
在 个性化 → 屏幕保护程序 里，选「名画」或「U盘画作」后即可看到这个按钮。
en: Gallery and USB Art now have a Picture fit setting: Whole (show the full picture, with black bars where its shape differs) or Fill (crop the edges to fill the screen). Whole is the default.
Find it under Personalize → Screen saver after choosing Gallery or USB Art.

zh: 修复「名画」屏保偶发黑屏：画作改为并行下载、缓存先校验完整性再显示；某张画损坏时立即跳到下一张，不再黑屏等待。
「U盘画作」现在整幅显示、不再裁掉边缘：画面按原比例完整放进屏幕，多出的空间留黑边；并去掉会再次裁切的缓慢推近动画。
en: Fixed the occasional black screen in the Gallery screensaver: paintings now download in parallel, cache files are verified before display, and a damaged image skips straight to the next one instead of holding a black frame.

USB Art now shows each picture whole instead of cropping the edges: images fit the screen at their original aspect ratio with black letterbox bars, and the push-in animation that re-cropped them is off.

zh: 修正桌面小猫的焦点：在主页按遥控器「上」键，焦点现在先落到右上角的「设置」上，再往左可以依次到天气和日历。
其余焦点、桌面和小猫的其他行为不变。
en: Fixed the desk cat's focus: pressing Up on the home screen now lands first on the top-right Settings pill, from which Weather and Date are one step left.
All other focus and cat behaviour is unchanged.

zh: 新增两种和航拍并列的屏保：「名画」和「U盘画作」。
名画：29 幅世界名画（莫奈、梵高、塞尚、库尔贝等），首次联网下载到电视后离线可看，每幅带中文画名。
U盘画作：读取你 U 盘里的图片轮播（自动过滤 macOS 隐藏文件）；插好 U 盘并授权文件访问即可。
两者都支持左右键切换、画框白边，画面留白和字幕自动避让。
en: Two new screensavers alongside the films: Gallery and USB Art.
Gallery: 29 museum paintings (Monet, van Gogh, Cezanne, Courbet and more), downloaded once then available offline, each with its title.
USB Art: slideshows your own pictures from a USB drive (macOS junk files filtered out); plug in and allow file access.
Both support left/right stepping and the picture frame; captions stay clear of the mat.

zh: 屏保可以变成画框了：画面四周加一圈细白边，让电视看起来像一幅挂画。个性化 → 屏幕保护程序 → 画框白边里可以开关，默认开启。
白边对所有屏保都生效（航拍、照片、我的视频、时钟），时间和地名会自动避开白边，不会被遮住；偏好设置关闭后画面照常铺满全屏。
en: The screensaver can now look like a framed print: a thin white mat around the picture. Turn it on or off under Personalize → Screensaver → Picture frame; on by default.
The frame applies to every screensaver (aerial, photos, your videos, clock); the time and place name stay clear of it. Switch it off for an edge-to-edge picture.

zh: 桌面小黑猫换回之前那版手绘形象：圆脑袋、竖耳、大琥珀眼加竖瞳、白胡须、卷尾，肚子上那颗金色小铃铛也回来了。
焦点提示改成落在猫肚子那颗铃铛上：用遥控器选中它时，铃铛外面亮起一圈金环，不再有整只猫的白色光圈，也不会被放大。
en: The desk cat is back to the hand-drawn look: round head, upright ears, big amber eyes with upright pupils, white whiskers, curled tail — and the little gold bell on its belly.
Focus now lands on that bell: selecting the cat lights a gold ring around it, with no white halo around the whole cat and no zoom.

zh: 修好了小黑猫的身材：之前它的脸被横向拉宽了 13%，现在按原片比例显示，脸型和视频里一致。
猫的下边缘不再是硬切的一刀，改成柔和渐隐并加了淡淡的落地投影，趴在壁纸上不会像贴纸。
en: Fixed the desk cat's proportions: its face was being stretched 13% wider than the video; it now keeps the original aspect ratio.
The cat's bottom edge is no longer a hard cut — it fades out softly and gets a faint contact shadow, so it sits on the wallpaper instead of looking pasted on.

zh: 桌面小黑猫换成了真正会动的样子：直接从你家猫的视频里逐帧抠出来，眨眼、歪头、探头都是原片动作。
角落里日历、天气、设置不再自动弹出面板了，想看的时候按遥控器选中再打开；个性化里有开关可以改回来。
小黑猫身上的白色焦点圈去掉了：它探出头本身就表示被选中，画面更干净。
en: The desk cat is now the real animation: every frame was cut out of your cat video, so the blinks, head tilts and peeks are the original motion.
The calendar, weather and settings corners no longer pop their panels open by themselves — select one with the remote to open it. A switch in Personalisation brings the old behaviour back.
The white focus ring around the cat is gone: it being out of hiding is the selection cue, so the wallpaper stays clean.

zh: 修复了桌面小黑猫会挡住焦点的问题：现在方向键可以正常到达左上角的日历、右上角的天气和设置了。
用遥控器选中小黑猫按 OK，它会真的「喵」一声，配合蹦跳和台词气泡陪你玩。
en: Fixed the desk cat blocking focus: the D-pad now reaches the calendar, weather and settings corners again.
Select the cat and press OK — it now lets out a real meow, with a hop and a speech bubble.

zh: 桌面小黑猫玩偶改成了会躲猫猫的互动方式：平时缩进屏幕右边缘、只露一点耳朵，用遥控器操作时才悄悄探出头来张望。
它探出后毛色带柔和高光、琥珀眼睛有微光，脚下还有淡淡的投影；静置几秒没人理它，就自己缩回边缘藏好。
探头时用遥控器选中它按 OK，它照样会蹦一下并冒出台词气泡；不影响方向键在角落与应用之间切换，个性化里仍可随时开关。
en: The desk cat now plays hide-and-seek: it tucks behind the right edge showing just one ear, and only sneaks out to peek when you use the remote.
Out in the open it has a soft gradient sheen, a gentle glow in its amber eyes and a faint contact shadow. Leave it alone for a few seconds and it retreats to the edge again.
While it is out, focus it with the remote and press OK for a hop and a speech bubble. Direction keys still move between corners and apps as before, and it stays switchable in Personalize.

zh: 桌面迎来一只小黑猫玩偶：琥珀色的眼睛、竖起的耳朵、白胡须和卷尾巴，按你家小黑猫的样子画成了 Q 版，坐在壁纸上有呼吸、眨眼、甩尾巴的小动作。
用遥控器选中它按 OK，它会蹦一下并冒出一句台词（喵～、摸摸我呀…）。玩偶不会挡住应用和角落，也不影响方向键在角落与应用之间切换。
在「个性化 → 桌面布局」里可以随时开关玩偶。
en: A little black cat now sits on the wallpaper: amber eyes, upright ears, white whiskers and a curled tail, drawn in a rounded style after the owner's own cat. It breathes, blinks and swishes its tail while it waits.

Focus it with the remote and press OK: it hops and says a short line (meow, pet me…). It never covers the apps or the corners, and direction keys still move between corners and apps exactly as before.
Turn the cat on or off any time in Personalize → Home Layout.

zh: 新增 Android 4.0–4.4 支持：单独的小黑DESK Lite（包名 app.orchard.tv.lite，minSdk 14），用原生 View 重写界面，和完整版并存、分开升级。
Lite 保留了应用网格与文件夹、时钟/农历/天气、控制中心、个性化、航拍与照片屏保、手机配置页和家长模式；没有桌面守护、航拍壁纸、信号源磁贴和应用内升级。
Lite 同步了 1.0.5 的天气容灾：Open-Meteo 失败自动切挪威气象局，断网保留最近读数 12 小时。
完整版本身支持 Android 5.0–6.0，本次界面与功能无改动，只需在设置里确认版本号为 1.0.8。
en: Android 4.0–4.4 is now supported by a separate xiaoheiDESK Lite (package app.orchard.tv.lite, minSdk 14), rewritten with plain Views and upgraded independently from the full app.

Lite keeps the app grid and folders, clock with lunar calendar and weather, Control Center, personalisation, aerial and photo screensavers, the phone page and kids mode. It has no Home guard, no aerial wallpaper, no source tiles and no in-app update.
Lite also gets the 1.0.5 weather fallback: when Open-Meteo fails it switches to Norway's MET, and the last reading survives 12 hours offline.
The full app already supported Android 5.0–6.0; its UI and features are unchanged in this release.

zh: 日历、天气、控制中心三个面板换成深色烟熏玻璃卡片：壁纸清晰透出，细亮描边、大圆角、白字，比原来的浅白玻璃更透、更安静。
焦点预览时三块面板缩到同一高度，天气与日历不再压住下方的应用图标；按 OK 展开后仍是原来的完整尺寸与全部内容。
其余功能与 1.0.6 一致：焦点即弹面板、方向键继续在角落间切换、天气双源容灾、自有版本更新检测。
en: The calendar, weather and Control Center panels now use dark smoke-glass cards: the wallpaper shows clearly through them, with a fine lit rim, large corners and white type, quieter and more see-through than the old pale glass.
Focus previews are scaled to one common height, so the weather and calendar no longer cover the app row below. Opening a panel with OK still shows it at full size with all of its content.
Everything else is unchanged from 1.0.6: panels follow focus, direction keys keep moving between corners, dual-source weather fallback and the self-hosted update channel.

zh: 焦点落在左上角的日期、右上角的天气或设置上时，自动弹出对应面板（日历、逐小时天气、控制中心），不必再按一次确认键。
面板弹出时焦点仍留在桌面：左右键继续在日期、天气、设置之间切换，面板跟着换；按上下键回到应用时面板自动收起。想操作面板（翻月份、调设置）再按 OK，进入后的行为与之前完全一致。
预览时面板不加全屏遮罩、不抢焦点，也不截获方向键和返回键，壁纸与其余桌面保持原样。
其余界面与 1.0.5 一致，包含天气双源容灾与自有版本更新检测。
en: The date (top left), weather and settings (top right) now open their panels as soon as focus lands on them: calendar, hourly forecast and Control Center, with no extra OK press.

Focus stays on Home while a panel is showing: Left/Right keeps moving between the corners and the panel follows; Up/Down returns to the apps and the panel closes. Press OK to enter the panel itself (step months, change settings), which behaves exactly as before.
A peek adds no scrim, takes no focus and swallows no direction or Back keys, so the wallpaper and the rest of Home are untouched.
Everything else is unchanged from 1.0.5, including the weather fallback and the self-hosted update channel.

zh: 修复天气获取失败：电视网络短暂抖动或 Open-Meteo 连不上时，天气与逐小时预报会一直空白，要等下一次刷新才恢复。
新增备用天气源（挪威气象局 api.met.no，同样免密钥）。主源超时或返回异常时自动切换，数据会转换成原有格式，天气面板的布局、图标与间距完全不变。
主源超时缩短到 5 秒，失败即刻走备用源；备用结果缓存 10 分钟，避免重复请求。断网时保留最近一次读数的时间从 3 小时延长到 12 小时，重启后也不会立刻空白。
逐小时预报失败后也会参与自动重试，网络恢复时随当前天气一起补上；其余界面与 1.0.4 一致。
en: Fixed weather failing to load: a brief network outage or an unreachable Open-Meteo left the clock and hourly forecast blank until the next hourly refresh.

Added a fallback source (Norway's MET Locationforecast, api.met.no, also keyless). When the primary host times out or answers badly the app switches automatically, converting the data into the existing shape so the weather panel's layout, icons and spacing are untouched.

The primary timeout is now 5 seconds, so a failure falls through quickly; fallback responses are cached for 10 minutes. The last good reading now survives 12 hours instead of 3, so a restart during an outage still shows the weather.
A failed hourly forecast now joins the automatic retry and is refetched together with the current weather when the network returns. Everything else is unchanged from 1.0.4.

zh: 角落时钟的「日期 / 星期 / 时间」改为两段等距：日期与星期之间、星期与时间之间都用 12dp 间距，读起来更整齐。
仅调整这一行的排版，日期的「11 / 12」样式、时间格式与其他界面保持不变。
en: The corner clock's date, weekday and time now have equal 12dp gaps on both sides of the weekday, so the line reads evenly.
Typography-only change: the 11 / 12 date, time format and every other screen are untouched.

zh: 修复 App 内「下载并安装」失败：部分电视能查到新版本，却连不上 github.com 的下载域名，安装包一直下载不下来。
改为优先走电视可达的 api.github.com 发布资产接口下载，并保留仓库副本与 GitHub Release 两个备用地址；下载后仍会校验包名、签名与版本号。
包含 1.0.2 的左上角日期排版（11 / 12 周四）与 1.0.1 的自有版本更新检测，其余界面不变。
en: Fixed 'Download and Install' failing on TVs that can reach the version check but cannot connect to github.com's release download host.

The APK is now fetched through the reachable api.github.com release-asset endpoint first, with a copy in the repo and the two GitHub release links as fallbacks; package name, signature and version are still checked before installing.
Includes 1.0.2's spaced corner date (11 / 12) and 1.0.1's own release channel. Everything else is unchanged.

zh: 桌面左上角日期由「11/12 周四」改为「11 / 12 周四」：月、日之间加入两侧留白的斜杠，字距更舒展，与后面的时间层次更清晰。
仅调整左上角小日期的排版，时间、周几、屏保大时钟、日历与天气面板均保持原样。
en: The corner date now reads 11 / 12 周四 instead of 11/12 周四: a spaced slash gives the month and day more breathing room and separates the date from the time.
Typography-only change; the clock, weekday, screensaver clock, calendar and weather panels are untouched.

zh: 更新检测改用小黑DESK 自己的版本线：只比较自己的 GitHub Release，不再把上游的新版本误报为可升级版本，也不会下载官方安装包。
控制中心「更新」页常驻显示各版本新特性，中英文随系统语言切换，离线也能查看。
有新版本时从自己的 Release 下载安装；二维码直达小黑DESK 版本下载页。
更新提示、下载失败提示与文案全部改为自有版本说明。
en: Update checks now follow the xiaoheiDESK version line: only our own GitHub releases are compared, so an upstream release is never offered or downloaded.
The Control Center update page always lists what each version brings, in Chinese or English, even offline.
New releases are downloaded from our own release assets; the QR code opens our release page.
Update and download-failure messages now describe our own release channel.

zh: 正式版首发，App 与仓库可见名统一为「小黑DESK / xiaoheiDESK」。
全新图标：黑玻底 + 两只白色三角猫耳 + 一条卷尾，同步替换桌面图标、adaptive icon 与 TV 横幅。
桌面日期 / 天气 / 设置获得焦点时改为白字 + Quiet Glass 玻璃高光；选中 App 时仅在名称文字下显示玻璃胶囊，图标保持原样。
日历 / 天气 / 设置三个面板统一为与桌面焦点同款的玻璃材质。
农历日历：初一显示农历月名，节日标注优先（含清明），农历与公历节日同屏。
天气面板：城市设为杭州，支持雨量、12 小时预报；小时图标等宽，与未来一周左右对齐。
HOME 键双向切换自定义桌面与系统桌面，带防抖与前台守护。
苹果航拍屏保、照片库、控制中心、诊断导出等完整功能保留。
en: First official release, branded 小黑DESK / xiaoheiDESK throughout.
New icon: dark glass with two small white cat ears and a curled tail, applied to the launcher icon, adaptive icon and TV banner.
Focus styling: white text on glass for date, weather and settings; a glass capsule under an app's name only, with the icon untouched.
Calendar, weather and settings panels share the same glass finish as the home focus.
Lunar calendar: month name on the first day, festival labels take priority (including Qingming), lunar and solar holidays together.
Weather panel: Hangzhou, rainfall, 12-hour forecast, evenly spaced hour icons aligned with the weekly rows.
HOME toggles between this desk and the stock launcher in both directions, with debounce and a foreground guard.
Apple aerial screensavers, photo library, Control Center and diagnostics export all kept.
